meta.title: Regret after the bidding window has closed
gaps: No operation or library case expresses regretting or withdrawing an unopened draft bid after the round closes, so the decisive regret request is not included and its HTTP 200 response cannot be asserted.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for only about two minutes.
steps: QA vendor 1 opens a draft bid while bidding is open.
Wait until the bid window and extra closing time have passed.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
